assertion.statement: For the actual rational elliptic curve E in (RC), full Z_2-corank Sel_(2^infinity)(E/Q)=1 implies w(E/Q)=-1.
assertion.objects: The same E/Q and its full 2-primary Selmer group used in (RC), including the divisible part of Sha.
assertion.hypotheses: E is an elliptic curve over Q; its full Selmer corank is one, supplied separately by the RC antecedent.
assertion.quantifiers: For every such E/Q with full corank one.
assertion.parameter_range: Base Q and p=2; no number-field generalization is used.
assertion.uniformity: An exact sign identity; no quantitative uniformity is claimed.
assertion.normalizations: The source rank r_2 equals Mordell-Weil rank plus the Q_2/Z_2 multiplicity in Sha, hence full Z_2 Selmer corank by the Kummer sequence.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No finite-Sha, ordinary reduction, semistability or rational-isogeny hypothesis is added. Finite Sha summands contribute zero corank.
assertion.limit_order: The direct-limit Kummer sequence identifies coranks before applying the parity theorem; the corank-one premise is not deduced from the desired analytic conclusion.

use.reason: The RC setup and odd-witness construction consume the same full-corank parity implication. The source wrapper is a project paraphrase of the independently checked final publisher theorem, not a claim to be the original publication.
use.shared_contract_justification: Both consumers use the same E/Q, p=2, full-corank-one antecedent and root-number output; later BFH choices are separate uses.

supplier.statement: For every elliptic curve E/Q and every prime p, (-1)^(r_p(E/Q))=w(E/Q), where r_p is Mordell-Weil rank plus the divisible p-primary Sha multiplicity.

publication.title: On the Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer quotient modulo squares
